output.reason: [ev-989a451dfcd4] lists the removal of StripPrefix `forceSlash` as a general dynamic-configuration change, not one limited to the traefik.io Middleware CRD. The v3.0.0 reference still ships a traefik.containo.us Middleware CRD [ev-8a887e659370], and configuration can also come from non-Kubernetes providers. So the proposed condition misses exposed environments. The schema validator found the field still in the v3.0.0 traefik.io schema [ev-0842f8f3bd9d], but setting the option is still the right trigger, so I widened the condition rather than changing its predicate.

correction.statement: The forceSlash option of the StripPrefix middleware was removed in Traefik 3.0.0. Exposed: any environment that sets forceSlash on a StripPrefix middleware, whether through a traefik.io or traefik.containo.us Middleware resource or through other dynamic-configuration providers.

of.needed: whether non-Kubernetes dynamic configuration (file provider, labels, KV stores) sets forceSlash on a StripPrefix middleware
